text:
rachel (partnerships): Quick heads-up: vendor asked for one embargo carrier but wants APAC later due to region-specific validation. Need a short failover plan + marketplace caveats.
owen (vendor-liaison): MI300 microcode still TBD; vendor suggests we announce H100/H200/B200 on one date and gate MI300 per-region.
mei (eng): Technical options: (1) ship with "compat mode" driver (older kernel) giving ~10% perf hit, (2) hold MI300 until microcode lands. Compat mode is safe but must be explicit in SKU metadata.
carmen (marketplace): Marketplace requires 14-day lead for verified images. If using compat mode, we need to publish SKU with "compat-mode" flag and the perf tradeoffs. We'll also need an APAC caveat.
tom (solutions): For SIs, recommend 1) publish both perf baselines (nominal, compat-mode), 2) mandatory one-day dry run in staging, 3) support contact for tuning.
press-bot: Suggest neutral language: "regional availability and compatibility modes may apply; refer to product notes". Avoid words like "delay" or "bug".
rachel (partnerships): Proposed timeline: internal GTM/legal brief Apr 10, partner packet Apr 17, public NA/EU announce Apr 24 with H100/H200/B200 and MI300 marked "regional rollouts"; APAC GA after validation.
owen (vendor-liaison): I'll push vendor for microcode ETA by Apr 12. If not nailed, we default MI300 to compat-mode in APAC and include update roadmap.
mei (eng): Action: finalize compat-mode driver docs + test IDs by Apr 14. If compat-mode used, include sample config snippet for power/thermal tuning:
```
# example prod tuning
redwood run --gpu=mi300 --compat-mode=true --max-seq=1024
```
carmen (marketplace): I'll prepare SKU templates and the partner-facing caveat copy by Apr 15. tom, can you draft the perf baselines?
tom (solutions): Yep—baseline artifacts and dry-run schedule by Apr 13.
rachel (partnerships): Recap actions: vendor ETA Apr 12 (owen), perf baselines/dry-run Apr 13 (tom), compat docs Apr 14 (mei), marketplace copy Apr 15 (carmen). Target announce NA/EU Apr 24; APAC rolling per validation. I'll follow up with press-ops and legal. :white_check_mark:
